notes: Read both target units, the full Iraq-to-Afghanistan context, all thirteen candidates and the review. Identified the special-forces and intelligence capacity as U.S. capacity. Restored the additional $1 billion in annual nonmilitary assistance as the mechanism for helping Afghans educate children, provide services and grow their economy, while preserving Afghans as the actors providing services and growing the economy.

claims.claim_text: Commitment to build U.S. special-forces and intelligence capacity for the Afghanistan campaign.
Commitment to use an additional $1 billion in annual nonmilitary assistance to help Afghans educate their children, including girls.
Commitment to use an additional $1 billion in annual nonmilitary assistance to help Afghans provide basic human services to their population.
Commitment to use an additional $1 billion in annual nonmilitary assistance to help Afghans grow their economy from the bottom up.
